task.description:
Implement frontend for TM-04/TM-05 tenant lifecycle controls per design:

1. Add deactivate/reactivate actions to tenant management UI (TenantsPage) with confirmation UX.
2. Show state-driven controls (Deactivate only for ACTIVE; Reactivate only for INACTIVE).
3. Integrate lifecycle API calls in web/src/api/tenants.ts and query invalidation updates.
4. Surface deterministic error messages for invalid input/forbidden/not-found/inactive-policy codes per design mapping.
5. Ensure PLATFORM_ADMIN-only visibility and behavior remain intact.

Validation required:
- cd web && npm run type-check
- cd web && npm run lint
- cd web && npm run build
- Relevant Playwright E2E updates for TM-04/TM-05 flows

Commit and push to feature/WF02-f8-batch2-20260607.
acceptance_criteria: UI supports deactivate/reactivate controls with confirmation
API integration and cache refresh behavior works

result.summary: Implemented TM-04/TM-05 tenant lifecycle controls with state-driven deactivate/reactivate actions, confirmation dialog UX, lifecycle API integration, deterministic error mapping, and focused Playwright E2E coverage.
